evidence.exact_span: In Reckitt and Colman Products Ltd v Borden Inc (1990) 17 IPR 1 at 7, in a passage which has been referred to with approval by two Full Courts of this Court, Lord Oliver identified three elements which have to be demonstrated in order for an applicant to succeed in a passing off action.
Deckers acknowledges that it has not presented any such evidence on the present application.
